synopsis: TMeasy is one of the tire-model families named in the booklet, alongside Fiala and Magic Formula (Pacejka) [f13780]. The glossary states that all three assume a firm surface [f13782]. Consistently, Chapter 11 reports the Project Chrono developers’ view that these handling tire models do not work with deformable terrain; only rigid or FEA tires and tracked vehicles do [f8498]. The supplied facts therefore identify a terrain-compatibility constraint for TMeasy, but provide no TMeasy-specific performance results or validation evidence [f8498, f13780, f13782].

relations.note: Firm-surface assumptions support the reported incompatibility with deformable terrain in Project Chrono.
Adds a shared firm-surface assumption to the listed tire-model families.
